title: Capitol Civic Centre

services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: There are many reasons why you may choose to rent the Capitol facilities. The West Auditorium-a 1,000-seat house-is not only grand but is acoustically exceptional. In addition to traditional on-stage performances, the theater is appropriate for large-attendance presentations and corporate meetings. The Capitol Grand Lobby provides versatile accommodations for a wide variety of events. You may choose to use the entire area, including the Salutz Family Lobbies with concession and mingling space or you may prefer a more intimate setting in The Mertens Lounge.
